dominant.architecture: Single shared encoder -> decoupled attribute and structure decoders

dlg_base.architecture: Decoupled local-to-global encoder with learned alpha gating -> decoupled decoders

differentiation.encoder_separation: DOMINANT forces one encoder for both scales; DLG-Base maintains separate local & global representations
differentiation.adaptive_gating: Learned alpha = 0.6145 balances local neighborhood vs multi-hop global context
